requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Lexical ambiguity ('preferably') resolved by Agent 2 via business rule BR-01, establishing a mandatory obligation. Structural issue 'concern_mixing' detected per Pohl §25.2: the requirement mixes a functional action (reset) with a quality criterion (mandatory/obligation). Decomposed into one functional requirement and one quality requirement.

structured_requirements.final_statement: When leaving Factory mode, the ECU shall perform a reset.
structuring_notes: Extracted functional action 'perform a reset'. Replaced 'preferably' with 'shall' based on supported interpretation from BR-01.

structured_requirements.final_statement: The ECU reset operation shall be mandatory when leaving Factory mode.
structuring_notes: Extracted quality criterion (mandatory obligation) as a separate artefact per Pohl §25.2. The specific mention of 'critical control modules' in BR-01 is treated as a constraint on the applicability of the requirement rather than part of the requirement text itself, to avoid unsupported inference.

unsupported_inferences_avoided: Did not explicitly include 'critical control modules' in the requirement text; treated as a constraint on applicability per Pohl §25.2.
